_note: Generated by pokebonk-web/tools-re/make_placeholders.py. These assets are requested by the web bundle at runtime but are absent from pokebonk-web and could not be pulled because pokebonk.com resets TLS from this network. Each entry states the substitution currently used by the Godot port. | UPDATE 2026-11-03: pokebonk-re holds a complete offline mirror (4.4k files), so most of these gaps closed by copying from it; see docs/PORT_STATUS.md "参考源切换到 pokebonk-re".

remote_probe.also_checked: https://github.com/juzi123451/pokebonk-web tree listing (561 files) -- no cries/, no species .glb, no env atlas.json present

entries.web_path: assets/models/<speciesKey>.glb (assumed; NOT actually requested for species by the bundle)
entries.substitute: PbVisuals.avatar(): PMD sheet billboard from data/sprites.json, then assets/front/<dex>.png, then a BoxMesh tinted from pokemon.json color/height/weight. The .glb branch is whitelist-only (PbVisuals.SPECIES_MODEL_KEYS) because assets/models/*.glb are props/balls/terminals, not species models.
entries.todo: None. Do not add prop glb names to SPECIES_MODEL_KEYS; only add a key when a real per-species model ships.
entries.resolution: Closed 2026-11-05: research confirmed the web build renders species as PMD billboards and reserves .glb for props/balls/terminals, so per-species .glb is neither present nor required. assets/models/porygon.glb is the Porygon event terminal (Cables/Terminal/Screen), not species 137; the avatar loader no longer infers models from species keys.
